project: Ledger Brain — Financial Well-Being Manager (Web Demo)
philosophy: Each task ships a working increment. No task depends on an unfinished task. You can demo after every checkmark. Target platform: Web (React Native Web).

tasks.name: Insight Engine — Pure Math (No LLM)
tasks.description: Build insights_engine.py with 5 pure-Python functions. No LLM calls. Just SQL + math. This is the brain's analytical core.

subtasks.name: compute_financial_dna()
subtasks.description: Shannon entropy of spending categories, top merchants, spend velocity ($/day), category concentration ratio.

subtasks.name: detect_anomalies()
subtasks.description: Z-score per merchant. Flag transactions > 2σ above mean. Also detect ABSENCE anomalies (merchant gap > 2x normal interval).

subtasks.name: detect_subscriptions()
subtasks.description: Find recurring charges: same merchant, ±1% amount, ~28-31 day intervals. Compute annual + 5-year projection.
subtasks.output: { subscriptions: [{ merchant, amount, interval_days, annual_cost, five_year_cost }] }

subtasks.name: forecast_cashflow(days=30)
subtasks.description: Predict inflows/outflows for next 30 days using recurring patterns + moving average. Flag projected zero-balance dates.

subtasks.name: compute_spending_velocity()
subtasks.description: Current $/day pace vs historical average. Return zone: green (<20% over), yellow (20-50% over), red (>50% over).

subtasks.name: Wire API endpoints
subtasks.description: Add POST /insights/generate (runs all 5 functions, stores in AgentInsight), GET /insights, GET /spending-velocity to main.py.

tasks.test: curl -X POST localhost:8001/insights/generate → returns structured JSON with all 5 insight types

tasks.name: LLM Narrator — Gemini Turns Math Into Cards
tasks.ship_artifact: POST /insights/generate returns generative UI card schemas
tasks.description: Build llm_narrator.py. Takes raw insight JSON from T1, sends to Gemini, gets back generative UI card schemas with titles, bodies, severity, actions.

subtasks.name: Card schema definitions
subtasks.description: Pydantic models for InsightCard, NudgeCard, ChartCard, ActionButton. Each card has card_type, icon, title, body, severity, actions[], visual{}.

subtasks.name: Gemini integration (Vertex AI)
subtasks.description: Connect to Gemini via google-cloud-aiplatform SDK. Single function: narrate_insights(raw_data) → list[CardSchema].

subtasks.name: Roast Mode prompt
subtasks.description: Craft the system prompt that makes Gemini generate savage, data-backed commentary. Feed all T1 outputs as context.

subtasks.name: DO / DON'T generator
subtasks.description: Prompt Gemini to output prescriptive advice as structured { do: [...], dont: [...] } arrays.

subtasks.name: Hook into /insights/generate
subtasks.description: After T1's raw analysis, pass results through narrator. Store card JSON in AgentInsight.card_schema column.

tasks.test: curl localhost:8001/insights → returns card JSON with card_type, severity, actions, and LLM-generated content

tasks.name: Pi Agent Core — Chat with Ledger
tasks.ship_artifact: POST localhost:8002/chat accepts natural language, returns narrated answers
tasks.description: Set up Pi Agent Core as a Node.js service. Connects to Gemini. Tools bridge to FastAPI. Handles multi-turn chat.

subtasks.name: Scaffold agent-node/
subtasks.description: npm init, install @mariozechner/pi-agent-core, @mariozechner/pi-ai, @sinclair/typebox. Create index.ts, tools.ts, server.ts.

subtasks.name: Configure Gemini provider
subtasks.description: Set up google provider with gemini-2.5-flash. Use GEMINI_API_KEY or Vertex AI ADC credentials.

subtasks.name: Define tools (bridge to FastAPI)
subtasks.description: query_transactions: calls GET localhost:8001/transactions. get_insights: calls GET localhost:8001/insights. check_velocity: calls GET localhost:8001/spending-velocity.

subtasks.name: System prompt (Ledger persona)
subtasks.description: Port SOUL.md into Pi Agent systemPrompt. Financial forensic analyst, concise, action-oriented, privacy-first.

subtasks.name: HTTP server wrapper
subtasks.description: Express server on port 8002. POST /chat accepts { message: string }, streams Pi Agent events back as SSE or JSON.

subtasks.name: Proactive context injection
subtasks.description: After answering the user's question, append 'also check if there are adjacent insights the user should know about' to the prompt.

tasks.test: curl -X POST localhost:8002/chat -d '{"message":"How much on Uber?"}' → agent calls FastAPI tool → returns narrated answer with proactive context
